arguments.command:
set -eu
echo '--- PS ---'
ps -eo pid,pcpu,pmem,rss,etime,args | grep -E '/webapp/miniconda/bin/ollama( |$)' | grep -v grep || true
echo '--- API_PS ---'
curl -fsS --max-time 4 http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/ps || true
echo
echo '--- TAGS_NAMES ---'
curl -fsS --max-time 4 http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags | /home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp/envs/openwebui/bin/python -c 'import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(m.get("name"),m.get("size"),m.get("details",{}).get("parameter_size"),m.get("details",{}).get("quantization_level")) for m in d.get("models",[])]' || true
echo '--- OLLAMA_LOG_TAIL ---'
tail -n 120 /home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp/ollama-runtime.log 2>/dev/null | grep -E -i 'load|unload|runner|memory|model|sched|request|generate' | tail -n 80 || true
